sections.title: Proseminar in History
sections.description: Weekly readings, discussions, and writing assignments to develop a global perspective within which to study human events in various regional/cultural milieus, c. 1400 to the present. This course is required for all PhD students, and is taken in the first year of study.

sections.title: Proseminar in History
sections.description: Weekly readings, discussions, and writing assignments designed to introduce students to the discipline of history. The emphasis is on critical approaches, global comparisons, and an expansive chronological frame for thinking about the past. This course is required for all PhD students, and is taken in the first year of study.
